# Articles a and an

## What you will learn
A and an introduce one nonspecific countable thing. Choose an before a vowel sound and a before a consonant sound.

## Example in context
an apple, an hour, a book, a university.

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
Choose by sound, not just spelling: a university begins with a /y/ sound.

## Practice and reflection
Fill in: ___ orange and ___ banana.
**Model answer:** an orange and a banana.

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.
